text:
marta: heads up: we're getting noisy fncall schema errors during streaming -> customers see gaps in tool responses. appears different from the partial-chunk JSON parse issue we fixed last quarter.

lee: can you paste an example error?

marta: sure. top-level event: `schema_error: missing_property 'result.items'` but the final assembled tool output contains `result.items` when we check the reassembled payload. looks like validator path resolution is confused when arrays are emitted in separate chunks.

priya: we've seen array boundaries be tricky with our current parser. streaming adapter emits array-open token in one chunk and items in later chunks. validator sees a momentary array-without-items and flags missing_property.

marta: repro snippet (simulated):
```json
{ "result": [
  "[",        // chunk 1
  "{ \"id\":1}", // chunk 2
  "]"        // chunk 3
]
}
```

lee: hrm. validator is synchronous and runs on every buffer append to enforce low-latency feedback. that gave us good early detection but yields false positives for arrays.

devops-bot: alert: fncall_stream_array_fragments spike (count: 78) in 15m on canary-7. link: https://console.internal/ir/alerts/1742003456

priya: proposal: change validator to tolerate "incomplete array" when stream mode is on. emit `fragment_array_warn` metric instead of `fncall_schema_reject`.

marta: we should avoid touching production path without a kill-switch. can we gate by feature-flag `stream_validation_relax` and default to safe?

lee: yes. implement flag with rollout to canary first. Also add an enriched tag `fragment_kind=array_boundary` to help filter in dashboards.

product-bot: product note: don't change quota semantics without PM sign-off. customers care about billing & quota.

priya: we'll keep billing tied to final rejects only. fragment warnings will not consume quota.

marta: telemetry request: backfill last 48h for `fragment_array_warn` using logs where validator fired during stream. tag samples with route, variant, client_id (hashed) and a short base64-encoded chunk_preview. retention 30d.

tim: UX: in the Console validation view can we show fragment warnings as a faint overlay (histogram) and allow toggling them off from alerts? default to hidden.

lee: implementing the backend bits:
- feature flag `stream_validation_relax` (FF service)
- emit `fragment_array_warn` & keep `fncall_schema_reject` for final fails
- add `fragment_kind` tag + `sample_id`
timeline: hotfix flag on canary in 4h, metric landing in 1d, console change in 6d.

marta: test plan: unit test multi-chunk arrays + e2e smoke job that streams simulated array outputs at various chunk boundaries. will add synthetic load to canary.

devops-bot: created ticket: RTV-4242 (fncall stream array-fragment warnings). assigned to lee & priya.

priya: one more thought: incremental parser might avoid most of these but it's non-trivial. treat it as follow-up (investigation 3w).

tim: please also draft a short customer-facing blurb if we need to call out noisy validation impacting console alerts. keep it non-technical.

marta: ok taking the hotfix and tests. will post PR link to RTV-4242 when ready.

lee: I'll wire the FF and metric emit. tagging SRE for rollout window.

priya: adding sampling rule: capture 0.5% of fragment events with full reassembly (PII scrub). query example for retrospective: `SELECT sample_id, route, fragment_kind FROM fncall_fragments WHERE rand() < 0.005`

marta: thanks all. sync in 2h after canary flip. :thumbsup:
